name: x402-data-api
description: Data API for AI agents: live web search JSON, real-time news sentiment, trends, crypto news sentiment, SEC EDGAR company intelligence and comparison, pre-flight x402 security audit, agent transaction risk preflight, market convergence index, clean markdown from URL, AI topic briefing, AI summarization, $1.00 research bundle, and vector-ready research dossier. 41 paid tools (POST + JSON body), 5 free GET /check previews.
